arguments.value: This agreement is between Domini Advisor Trust and Domini Social Investments LLC (Domini), dated February 4, 2005. Domini will serve as sponsor for the Trust and provide oversight, administrative, and management services, such as office support, coordinating service providers, preparing filings and reports, maintaining records, assisting with meetings and shareholder inquiries, supporting compliance, and helping with budgets and insurance. The Trust keeps responsibility for managing its assets and investment advice. In return, the Trust pays Domini a fee equal to 0.50% of the Trust’s average daily net assets, paid monthly, and the Trust pays its own operating expenses. Domini is not liable except for willful misfeasance, bad faith, gross negligence, or reckless disregard of duties. The services are nonexclusive. The agreement took effect on February 4, 2005 and continues until terminated by either party or the Trust’s Board on at least 60 days’ written notice. It may be changed only in writing signed by both parties. Massachusetts law governs the agreement.
